source.quote_free_summary: Chief judge and scoring/tabulation functions and duties must be provided by separate individuals.

requirement: Chief judge and scoring operator are different accounts; one account cannot hold both official roles; the result calculator must not be the chief judge.
enforcement_point: Planned (design: docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-05-conflicts-design.md section 6A): database triggers on officials, designations and result versions. Not built.
interpretation_notes: Two accounts of one human are not detectable. Design only (PR-A): nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed. Applies only to WSDC-declared events; never imposed on NDCA, UCWDC or Studio/Custom.
